plan.title: Add Bid drawer shows vendor sheet

steps.note: Open the prepared event's Participants tab.
Ensure the participant list and Add Bid controls are rendered.
Click Add Bid on the first eligible vendor row to open that vendor's bid drawer.
Verify the vendor bid drawer opened using a known rendered label.
Verify the drawer identifies the vendor selected from the row.
Verify the drawer contains the event's line-item sheet.
Verify the event quantity column is present in the sheet.
Verify the bid price column is present in the sheet.
